features.headline: Key Features to Elevate Your Coaching

cards.description: Easily implement state frameworks like LEADS or upload and map your district's unique instructional rubrics. Ensure consistency and relevance in every observation.

cards.title: Actionable Growth Tracking

how_it_works.headline: Get Meaningful Feedback Flowing in 3 Steps

steps.title: Observe & Align
steps.description: Capture evidence during walkthroughs using our simple form on any device, tagging notes directly to your chosen rubric indicators.

steps.title: Generate & Refine
steps.description: Instantly get AI-suggested feedback based on your notes. Review, personalize, and finalize coaching points in minutes, not hours.

steps.title: Track & Support
steps.description: Monitor progress with real-time dashboards. Leverage insights from observation logs and trend data for effective follow-up and support.

questions.question: How accurate is the AI feedback?
questions.answer: Our AI provides strong, rubric-aligned starting points based on your notes. It's designed to be reviewed and personalized by the coach for maximum relevance and impact.

questions.question: Can we use our district's specific rubric?
questions.answer: Yes! Our School and District plans feature a flexible engine allowing you to easily upload and map your unique instructional frameworks alongside standards like LEADS.

questions.question: How secure is our school's data?
questions.answer: Extremely. We use industry-leading partners (Convex & Clerk) for encrypted storage, secure authentication (MFA available), and adhere to strict data privacy protocols designed for education.

questions.question: What integrations are available?
questions.answer: We are actively developing integrations with systems like Google Classroom, Clever, and Apple School Manager. District partners often get early access.

questions.question: Is there a free trial or pilot program?
questions.answer: We plan to offer trials and pilot programs. Join the waitlist to be the first to know about availability and receive early access opportunities!
